metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Wait, you actually hit that?!’
metadata.description:
Wasn’t aiming but the kill still landed.
Enemy probably confused how I survived.
Valorant logic: ‘We don’t know how either.’
Click if your aim’s broken but your kills aren’t!

Smash like if your aim ghosts but the kills keep showing up!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
